probe.question: When a fresh role-local successor has diverged from the stale predecessor and does not contain the pending stale effect key, can recovery avoid blind stale replay while still defining a bounded successor-relative child transition with at-most-once semantics?
recovery_rule: If pending effect key is present in the fresh successor, classify the effect committed and suppress replay.
If pending key is absent and current pointer still equals the recorded predecessor, permit one CAS-guarded replay whose key is atomically stored with the effect.

If pending key is absent and current pointer differs from the recorded predecessor, forbid stale replay. Re-derive intent relative to the fresh successor, bind a child effect key to that successor fingerprint, and permit at most one CAS-guarded child write.

After ambiguous acknowledgement, fresh-read once on a later recovery step: key present means committed; unchanged pointer plus absent key permits one retry; divergent pointer plus absent key aborts and requires another successor-relative re-derivation. Never poll or retry repeatedly in one invocation.

result.scope: Formal deterministic state-machine only. The live repository branch was freshly read and CAS identities are real, but this slice did not inject a concurrent writer, transport fault, or destructive divergent LATEST mutation.
result.falsified_failure_mode: A stale pending effect must not be blindly replayed merely because its key is absent from a divergent successor.
result.required_atomicity: Effect payload and deterministic effect key must be committed in the same CAS-guarded pointer mutation for the at-most-once proof to apply.

exact_continuation: On the next valid invocation, execute one recurrence-sensitive reconstruction probe for a missing or unreadable role-local LATEST pointer: using only own immutable neuroscience artifact/receipt lineage, define the minimum predecessor chain needed to reconstruct the current Phase-1 checkpoint without reading other roles or shared ledgers. Test one deterministic missing-pointer and one stale-pointer branch in a single bounded model, require exact authority provenance and no duplicate logical advance, persist/read back, and stop without a second leaf.
